summary: KKR Infrastructure Conglomerate LLC filed an 8-K to disclose its monthly transactional net asset value (NAV) per share as of May 31, 2026. The NAV ranged from $30.48 (Class U) to $36.02 (Class G/H). This is a routine periodic valuation disclosure for a closed-end interval fund, not a special situation. The filing contains no M&A, activist, restructuring, or capital event; it is a standard regulatory update for a non-traded BDC-style entity. No action recommended.
